text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Fufu. My body is trembling a little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However, please do not worry. This is 
merely an ache in anticipation of the 
race."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are complete—all that's left 
is to bet everything on that single moment 
and unleash my full strength.
choice_data_list: Go out there and crush it!
Go out there and do your best!
